clips.title: The story
paras: In Teldrassil, water from the Oracle Tree's moonwell fills an amethyst phial. Corithras Moonrage receives it for the Cenarion druids to study the World Tree's troubled growth.

The Oracle Glade lies in northwest Teldrassil, where the oldest and most potent moonwell rests beneath the Oracle Tree. Other moonwells across the boughs meet the night elves' daily needs, but the water here carries the raw essence of Elune's grace. Druids who watch over the World Tree's health collect it in amethyst phials, preserving it for testing and ritual cleansing.
